name: avatar
purpose: Displays content or metadata in the UI. Lives at `packages/webkit/src/components/content/avatar/`.
useWhen: Identify a person next to their name: comment threads, member lists, "Last modified" cells, quotes.
The user entry in a header or account menu.
avoidWhen: A count or short status → use `badge`.
related: badge` — overlay on an avatar to show a count.
quote` — composes an avatar for the speaker.
brand` — the product mark, not a person.
bestPractices: Pass initials in `label` (`"JD"`); it keeps the first two characters, so a full name shows its first two letters, not initials.

Set `alt` to the person's name ("Jane Doe"). With `src` it is the image's `alt`; without an image it names the initials or icon fallback (`role="img"`), so a screen reader hears "Jane Doe", not "JD". Without `alt` the name falls back to the initials, then "Avatar" for an image or "User avatar" for the icon.
Content precedence is `src`, then `label`, then `icon` (default `pi pi-user`).
size` maps to 24 / 32 / 48 px with `medium` as the default; `kind` is `circle` (default) or `square`.

props.name: src
props.doc: Image URL. When set, renders a photo and takes precedence over label and icon.

props.name: alt
props.doc: Accessible name: the image's `alt` with `src`, and the name of the initials or icon fallback without it.

props.name: label
props.doc: Initials shown when no image (normalized to two uppercase characters).

props.name: icon
props.doc: Icon class for the fallback when no image or label (PrimeIcons class).

props.name: kind
props.doc: Visual shape of the avatar container.

props.name: size
props.doc: Size preset matching Figma sm / md / lg (24 / 32 / 48 px).

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Avatar from '@aziontech/webkit/avatar'
</script>

<template>
  <Avatar
    label="AB"
    kind="circle"
    size="medium"
  />
</template>
